candidates.summary: President Donald Trump arrived at Manila's Ninoy Aquino International Airport at 5:33 p.m. Philippine time (09:33 UTC) on November 17. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent accompanied him. The arrival began the Philippine stop of his Asia trip; subsequent meetings and agreements were not yet established as completed by the reporting reviewed.
candidates.title: Trump arrives in Manila for Philippine stop of Asia trip

candidates.summary: Bahrain's Defence Force announced November 17 that it had intercepted and destroyed Iranian aerial attacks. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it launched drones targeting a U.S.-operated radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base. Bahrain's Interior Ministry subsequently announced an all-clear following a threat alert. The reviewed reporting did not independently establish Iran's claim of a successful strike on the radar facility.
candidates.title: Bahrain reports intercepting Iranian aerial attacks; Iran claims U.S. radar target

candidates.summary: The Office for National Statistics released November labour-market figures showing provisional UK payroll employment fell by 34,000 between September and October, to 30.2 million. Vacancies fell by 22,000 over the quarter to August–October, to 690,000. Survey-based unemployment was estimated at 4.6% in July–September, down 0.3 percentage points on the quarter, but ONS cautioned that survey-sample rotation partly explained that decline. Annual regular earnings growth slowed to 3.5%, from 3.7% in the preceding three-month period.
candidates.title: UK payroll employment and vacancies fall as wage growth slows
